text.p: Shenergy Co Ltd, the largest power investment firm in Shanghai, said on Sunday its after-tax profit rose 9.78 percent to 557.58 million yuan in 1996 against 507.90 million in 1995.

In its 1996 annual report the Shanghai-listed A share company attributed the increase to returns from investment in major power projects. These included a 500 million yuan investment in the first stage of a power plant in the Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone in the Pudong New Area to the east of central Shanghai. Turnover rose 12.86 percent to 834.9 million yuan in 1996 from 739.77 million yuan in 1995, the report said.
Net assets per share increased 15.33 percent to 1.73 yuan from 1.50 yuan and earnings per share were little changed at 0.2118 yuan against 0.2114 yuan, the report said.
All figures are based on domestic accounting standards.

The company said it planned a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.16 yuan per share for all shareholders from its 1996 profits, pending the shareholder approval at a meeting scheduled for April 30. It offered the same return to investors in 1995.
By the end of 1996, the company had a total of 2,633.09 million outstanding shares, the report said.
Domestic A shares accounted for 161.35 million, the state owned 2,113.1 million shares, and institutions owned 269 million shares.
The company also had 89.64 million unlisted individual shares, which are rights shares for state and institutional shareholders sold to retail investors, the report said.
